LSP treatment was performed under the following parameters, the laser pulse duration of 15 ns, laser spot diameter of 2.5 mm, power density of 9.55 GW/cm2, overlapping rate of 60%, absorbing layer materials of black polyvinyl chloride (PVC) tape with thickness of 0.13 mm, and water confinement layer of 2 mm.

Based on the LSP treatment, the assistance of environment temperature 300 °C was introduced in WLSP treatment, highly pure aluminum foil with the thickness of 0.10 mm was used as absorbing layer, the silica glass with thickness of 2 mm was used as confinement layer, and the other parameters are as same as those for LSP treatment.

The movement of dislocation is strongly restricted by the γ″ phase under the shock load, leading to the entanglement of the dislocation and further formation the γ″ phase/dislocation complex structure

The high surface compressive residual stress will be helpful to balance the tensile stress between the surface and subsurface, contributing to the improvement of the fatigue resistance and delay fatigue crack initiation in the surface layer.

LSP- and WLSP treatments not only refine the grains in the surface hardening layer but also impede the initiation of the fatigue crack by the surface compressive residual stress, high dislocation density and the formation of the precipitates/dislocation complex.

It implies that the fatigue crack propagation in the surface hardening layer of LSP- and WLSP IN718 superalloys under the same stress level (950 MPa) is inhibited during the propagation of the fatigue cracks.
